purpose: Present host-owned setup steps with completion progress, optional actions and retryable operation feedback.
behaviorProvider: Shared Checkbox, ProgressBar, Button and feedback components with a local serialized action helper.

requirements.statement: Render completed state from each supplied item and request changes through onCompletedChange. Without that callback, completion checkboxes are read-only.
Count every supplied item, including optional items, in progress and completion. Completion requires a nonempty list with all items completed.
Serialize completion and step actions; while one is pending, disable owned step checkboxes/actions and present errors without inventing a completed state.
Invoke an item action only when its action and action label are supplied. Successful action execution does not automatically mark the item completed.
Toggle the step content through a button with expanded/controls semantics; keep a status announcement for completed local actions and mark the region busy for loading or pending work.
Render loading placeholders, supplied error with optional retry, no-step feedback, or completion footer according to props. Start again and dismiss delegate to host callbacks.
Provide stable unique item identifiers and update completion only after the product action is actually complete; decide how optional steps affect the supplied list.
Implement persistence, reset, dismissal and retry behavior. Pending promises are not canceled by collapse or dismissal, and those controls are not a blanket lock on the whole region.
Own pattern or component styling consumes workflow group tokens. Nested shared components retain their own group ownership; do not restyle their internals.

limitations: Optional is a presentation label, not exclusion from the completion denominator.
No persistence, dependencies between steps or verification of real-world completion.
Host callbacks own cancellation and route transitions; no AbortSignal is provided.
